creator: OpenAI ImageGen
purpose: Intermediate slim skin limbs; superseded by v2 to match native friendly head tones.
promptSet:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied six-column/four-row native skin limb sheet. Keep exact skin colors, grid centers, vertical positions and all four rows. Make adult limbs more SLENDER, not inflated:
Rows1and2 upper arms and forearms: reduce each part width by about20 percent around its existing vertical center axis, keep vertical heights unchanged. Maintain rounded shoulder/elbow caps and tapered wrists with generous rounded overlap material.
Rows3and4 open hands and thinking hands: preserve complete clear connected hand anatomy, thumb/fingers and wrist stem; make hand widths about10 percent narrower and keep heights unchanged. Widen/extend the top wrist stems just enough to overlap slender forearm ends naturally, without a visible detached seam. Wrist is at TOP, fingers point DOWN, same orientation as target.
Every column remains one EXACT matching uniform skin color. No new nail/knuckle lines, no wrist bands, no outlines, no darkening or shading. Strict flat opaque spot-color shapes. NO gradients, shadows, highlights, glow, texture, 3D or lighting. Preserve native alpha and completely transparent space between every cutout. No text or grid.
transformations: Original generated PNG bytes copied without repainting, tracing, alpha thresholding, color edits or post-processing. Runtime uses measured rectangular native viewports and uniform transforms.
fiction: Original fictional customization artwork, not portraits of real people.
